name: MJWaveFold
description: Plus redesign: 1-5 sine-folding stages, 4x oversampling, LOW/FULL/BLEND voices. Mono left. Never save.

params.name: Drive
params.explanation: Folding intensity; input trim follows the selected number of stages.

params.name: Symm
params.explanation: Alternating stage bias, centered at 50; no offset-only dead bands.

params.name: Voice
params.explanation: LOW: two-pole input low-pass. FULL: full-spectrum folding. BLEND: parallel clean signal.

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Matched output level; 50 is unity loudness.

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Linear dry/wet blend; dry aligned to the 12-sample oversampling delay.

params.name: Stages
params.explanation: One to five cascaded folding cells; input trim compensates for fewer stages.
